title: Marmot audit v5 typed Welcome and operational events
$comment: Strict JSONL record shape. The 44 operational event types retain typed v4 diagnostic facts with v5 source/session sequence, hashed group/message/endpoint and distinct legacy member reference domains. Record::new enforces Welcome cross-field semantics. Input framing, duplicates, and <=65535 bytes are checked before typed validation.

Operational_refHex16.description: Legacy v1 16-byte truncated member/account diagnostic hash; not a v5 MemberRef and never comparable to a Welcome member_ref.

Operational_messageId.description: Canonical Marmot message artifact id. For MLS content-bearing artifacts this is the SHA-256 digest of the MLS content bytes. Transport and on-wire ids must be recorded in transportWireEnvelope instead of overloading msg_id.

Operational_membershipChangeSource.description: Explains membership-removal attribution when change_kind alone is not enough. For example, member_removed with admin_action and an actor is an admin removal; member_removed with convergence and no actor is a convergence-resolved departure that must not be rendered as an admin action.

OperationalDiagnosticRef.description: Domain-separated hash of a legacy diagnostic identifier. It is not an authenticated Nostr event reference.
